items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: I remember him, but that's after he got out of this deal, I saw Baby Lewis in Dallas. He was a good drummer.

ctx.x: Clem Nurse, did you know him? No. Big Boi Whopper on Cherokee Church.
No, Baby Lewis. No, Baby Lewis. All this is way before I came. Yeah, I see.
And they mentioned Chili Jim of Waco. I think he plays piano much.
